Vitrified Ramp.name: Vitrified Ramp
Vitrified Ramp.description: The user sweeps both hands over loose rubble and broken concrete, fusing the pile with heat into a smooth, glassy rescue ramp up to a second-story window or across a street-wide gap, then quenches the surface as they run up it. The cooled glass holds the weight of a crowd so civilians can climb down bare-handed, though absorbing the heat of the whole ramp leaves the user's arms aching and hot. Strain: moderate.
